newsitem.title: GERMANY: Youths beat asylum seeker with bat - German police.
newsitem.headline: Youths beat asylum seeker with bat - German police.

text.p: Four youths attacked a 26-year-old asylum seeker in the eastern town of Freiberg, kicking him, beating him with a baseball bat and firing blank shots at him, German police said on Sunday.
They said the man, believed to be from Pakistan, was attacked in the early hours of Saturday morning. He was later taken to hospital for treatment.
A special commission was investigating the crime because it was assumed the attackers had racist motives.
In April a German court sentenced two young men to jail for a brutal racist attack with a baseball bat on two Italians which left one victim paralysed and barely able to speak.
Germany has tried hard to clamp down on racist and neo-Nazi groups since a three-year wave of anti-foreigner attacks after unification in 1990, in which more than 30 people died.

But the former communist east, plagued by high levels of unemployment, remains a focus for young right-wingers, who have carried out dozens of attacks on foreigners, vagrants and left-wing groups in the last few years.
